g.title: J_EPS_JET
g.text: EPS J18 (right-angle gold header, EPS bottom side, zone Z2): VBAT_JET behind SW1 and the eFuse U19

g.title: W5A
g.text: M22759/33-24, twisted quad (1+3, 2+4); 1.4 A design current on two wires per pole

g.title: J_JET_PWR
g.text: carrier J1 (right-angle gold header, plug from -X): DC input 11.2-16.4 V; TVS2200, LC filter, LM61440 5 V buck

g.title: J_OBC_JET
g.text: OBC J3 (4 to 6 pos, change E10): PA9 TX via U28, PA10 RX via U29, JET_3V3 to PG6 (10 k), PT_NTC to PA2 ADC1_IN7 (10.0 k bias from VDDA), PT_RTN to GND

g.title: W5B
g.text: 115200 baud, OBC transmits 8N2 (DS-11105-001 2.10.4), SMART-QSO-ICD-002 framing; signals twisted with ground; PT_NTC/PT_RTN a twisted pair. Signal currents under 5 mA

g.title: J_JET_UART
g.text: carrier J2: U11 B to module UART1 RXD (pin 205), U10 B from UART1 TXD (pin 203), 3V3_IO via 100 Ohm, NTC pass-through
